results.reader_title: Russia-Ukraine: Short-Term Energy Security Doctrines, Long-Term Climate Damage?
results.reader_what: An analysis of the 2022 Ukraine crisis warns that replacing Russian gas with LNG terminals could deepen European fossil-fuel lock-in.
results.reader_more: An analysis of the 2022 Ukraine crisis warns that replacing Russian gas with LNG terminals could deepen European fossil-fuel lock-in. The assessment is historical and prospective as of April 2022; it does not measure subsequent LNG outcomes or current Russian-gas dependency.
